summary: This article surveys the farm-to-table movement through seasonal salads and dressings, moving from September 2023 to August 2024. Each section features a chef, nutritionist or restaurant that launched a signature salad, with its ingredients and matching dressing. The final August section on Sunna's Garden's Summer Harvest Salad is cut off before giving a recipe.
one_line: A month-by-month tour of seasonal farm-to-table salads and dressings from chefs and restaurants, September 2023 through August 2024.
key_facts: Chef Emily Norton of The Green Fork in Vermont launched her Autumn Harvest salad on September 15, 2023.

Emily Norton's Autumn Harvest salad uses mixed greens with kale and arugula, roasted butternut squash, Bartlett pears, dried cranberries, toasted pumpkin seeds and goat cheese, with a cider vinaigrette of apple cider vinegar, olive oil, maple syrup, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Dr. Marco Silvestri hosted a workshop in Portland, Oregon on October 21, 2023 about building salads from root vegetables.

Dr. Marco Silvestri's Root Revival Salad has roasted beet and carrot ribbons over spinach with sunflower seeds, dressed in a ginger-tahini vinaigrette made with tahini, ginger, garlic, lemon juice and soy sauce.
Luisa Regatta, a chef and culinary blogger, showcased a Warm Winter Salad on November 12, 2023.

Luisa Regatta's Warm Winter Salad combines roasted sweet potatoes, blanched Brussels sprouts, pomegranate seeds, red onions, pecans and feta, with a warm honey-mustard dressing of Dijon mustard, honey, balsamic vinegar and olive oil.
Sprout & Co., a vegetarian restaurant in San Francisco, introduced the Citrus Kale Winter Salad on December 9, 2023.
The Citrus Kale Winter Salad has kale massaged with olive oil, red cabbage, leeks, oranges, grapefruits and toasted almonds, with a dressing of orange juice, lime juice, honey, vinegar and olive oil.
Jamie Lin, a chef and market owner in Asheville, North Carolina, shared her Spring Fling Salad on March 7, 2024 at a community farmer's market gathering.
Jamie Lin's Spring Fling Salad uses blanched asparagus, sugar snap peas, baby lettuces, edible flowers, radishes and spring onions, with a lemon, chive, olive oil and honey dressing.
Chef Fiona Byrne of The Wild Thyme Bistro in Galway, Ireland unveiled her Edible Flower and Berry Salad on May 14, 2024.
Fiona Byrne's salad pairs baby spinach and arugula with pansies, nasturtiums, lavender, strawberries, blueberries, walnuts and goat cheese, finished with a poppy seed dressing.
Sunna's Garden in Austin, Texas shared its Summer Harvest Salad on August 20, 2024, but the note ends before describing the recipe.
